mil7.3.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, sālakalyāṇikāya ekaṃ angaṃ ga- hetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.3.4:1.2: Yathā mahārāja sālakalyāṇikā antopaṭhaviyaṃ yeva abhivaḍḍhati hatthasatam-pi bhiyyo pi,
mil7.3.4:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena cattāri sāmaññaphalāni catasso paṭisambhidā chaḷ-abhiññāyo kevalañ-ca samaṇadhammaṃ suññāgāre yeva paripūrayitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.4:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja sālakalyāṇikāya ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
